questions.title: Recursive Factorial Drill
questions.description:
Read a non-negative integer N and print N factorial (N!) using a recursive function.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print N! as a single integer on its own line.

Constraints:
0 <= N <= 20

questions.title: Recursive Countdown Printer
questions.description:
Read a positive integer N and print numbers from N down to 1, each on its own line, using recursion.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines, each containing one integer from N to 1.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Recursive Natural Number Sum
questions.description:
Read a non-negative integer N and print the sum 1 + 2 + ... + N using a recursive function whose base case is N == 0 returning 0.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print the sum as a single integer on its own line.

Constraints:
0 <= N <= 1000

questions.title: Recursive Power Calculator x to n
questions.description:
Read an integer base X and a non-negative integer exponent N, then print X raised to the power N using a recursive function.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers X and N.

Output Format:
Print X^N as a single integer on its own line.

Constraints:
-10 <= X <= 10, 0 <= N <= 15

questions.title: Recursive Digit Sum Counter
questions.description:
Read a non-negative integer N and print the number of decimal digits in N using a recursive function.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print the digit count as a single integer on its own line.

Constraints:
0 <= N <= 1000000000

questions.title: Recursive Array Element Printer
questions.description:
Read an integer N followed by N integers, then print each integer on its own line using a recursive traversal of the array.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

Output Format:
N lines, each containing one integer in the original order.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= arr[i] <= 1000000

questions.title: Conveyor Belt Good Item Counter
questions.description:
A factory conveyor belt scans N items one by one. Each item has an integer quality code. A code greater than zero means the item passed inspection. Use a recursive function to count how many items passed.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integer codes.

Output Format:
Print the count of items with positive codes on its own line.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= code <= 1000000

questions.title: Recursive Message Length Counter
questions.description:
A messaging app receives a single-line message and reports how many characters are in it (excluding the trailing newline). Use a recursive function to count characters.

Input Format:
A single line of text (may contain spaces), at most 200 characters.

Output Format:
Print the character count on its own line.

Constraints:
1 <= message length <= 200

questions.title: Investment Doubler Yearly Calculator
questions.description:
An investor deposits P rupees in a scheme that doubles the principal every year. Compute the value of the investment after Y years using a recursive function.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers P and Y.

Output Format:
Print the final value as a single integer on its own line.

Constraints:
1 <= P <= 1000, 0 <= Y <= 30

questions.title: Sum Both Ways Iterative Recursive
questions.description:
A teaching tool demonstrates the equivalence of iteration and recursion by computing the sum 1 + 2 + ... + N both ways. Print the iterative result on the first line and the recursive result on the second line; both must be equal.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Two lines, each containing the sum 1 + 2 + ... + N.

Constraints:
0 <= N <= 100000

questions.title: Library Bundle GCD Calculator
questions.description:
A librarian wants to divide two stacks of books with M and N books into the largest possible equal-sized bundles with no books left over. Use a recursive Euclidean GCD function (no loops) to compute the bundle size.

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers M and N.

Output Format:
Print the GCD as a single integer on its own line.

Constraints:
0 <= M, N <= 1000000 (not both zero)

questions.title: Cargo Container Weight Recursive Sum
questions.description:
A shipping dock records the weight of N cargo containers in an array. The supervisor insists the total weight be computed using recursion only (no loops anywhere in the program, including for reading input). Print the total weight.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated integer weights.

Output Format:
Print the total weight as a single integer on its own line.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= weight <= 1000000

questions.title: Secret Message Length Counter
questions.description:
A cryptographer manually counts the characters of a secret message without using any string library function or any loop. Use a recursive function to compute the length of the message excluding the trailing newline.

Input Format:
A single line of text (may contain spaces), at most 200 characters.

Output Format:
Print the length as a single integer on its own line.

Constraints:
1 <= message length <= 200

questions.title: Genetic Strand Palindrome Validator
questions.description:
A geneticist checks whether a DNA strand reads the same forwards and backwards. The strand is a single line of uppercase letters with no spaces. Use a recursive function to decide if it is a palindrome; print 1 if it is, 0 otherwise. No loops or string reversal library functions allowed.

Input Format:
A single line of uppercase letters (length at most 200).

Output Format:
Print 1 if the strand is a palindrome, 0 otherwise.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 200, only uppercase A-Z

questions.title: Sorted Shelf Binary Search
questions.description:
A library shelf holds N book IDs in strictly increasing order. A librarian searches for a target ID using a recursive binary search function (no loops anywhere). Print the 0-based index of the target, or -1 if not found.

Input Format:
First line: integer N. Second line: N space-separated sorted integers. Third line: target integer.

Output Format:
Print the index of the target, or -1 if absent.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, -1000000 <= id <= 1000000

questions.title: Tower of Hanoi Move Counter
questions.description:
A puzzle enthusiast solves the Tower of Hanoi with K disks and wants to know the total number of disk moves required. Use a recursive function (no loops, no exponent library function) to compute the move count.

Input Format:
A single integer K.

Output Format:
Print the number of moves as a single integer on its own line.

Constraints:
1 <= K <= 30

questions.title: Numerology Digital Root Calculator
questions.description:
A numerology app reduces a number to its digital root by repeatedly summing its digits until a single digit remains. Use recursive functions only (no loops anywhere) to compute the digital root. For input 0, output 0.

Input Format:
A single non-negative integer N.

Output Format:
Print the digital root (a single digit 0-9) on its own line.

Constraints:
0 <= N <= 1000000000000000000

questions.title: Recursive Sentence Reverser and Vowel Counter
questions.description:
A text editor must reverse a sentence and report the number of vowels it contains, doing both jobs with recursive functions only. No loops and no string library functions are allowed. Print the reversed sentence on the first line and the vowel count on the second line.

Input Format:
A single line of text (may contain spaces, lowercase or uppercase letters), at most 200 characters.

Output Format:
Two lines: first the reversed sentence (excluding newline), then the vowel count.

Constraints:
1 <= length <= 200

questions.title: Fibonacci Both Ways Memoized
questions.description:
A biology class models rabbit population growth using the Fibonacci sequence. Compute the Nth Fibonacci number using BOTH a recursive function (with memoization) and an iterative loop. Print the recursive result on the first line and the iterative result on the second line; both must match.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Two lines, each containing the Nth Fibonacci number (F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1).

Constraints:
0 <= N <= 50

questions.title: Inline Geometry Area Calculator
questions.description:
A CAD tool computes the area of rectangles and circles using inline helper functions for performance. Read Q queries; each query specifies a type (1 = rectangle with width and height, 2 = circle with radius) and the dimensions. Print each area with exactly two decimal places.

Input Format:
First line: integer Q. Next Q lines: each contains type T followed by two values. For T=1 use width and height; for T=2 use radius (third value ignored).

Output Format:
Q lines, each containing the area with exactly two decimal places.

Constraints:
1 <= Q <= 1000, 0 <= width, height, radius <= 1000
